title: VeloraOS 1.10.34 - Final Answer Only Hotfix
releaseNotes: Stops Qwen models from narrating internal reasoning directly inside normal answer text.
Disables thinking for every user-facing Ollama generation while preserving Cosmic Reasoning answer-depth controls.
Uses Qwen /no_think and final-answer-only instructions on older Ollama builds.
Blocks plain-text model self-talk before persistence and hides leaked self-talk already present in older chats.
